name: melvor2-pocket
description: Personal portrait-mode web rebuild of the Melvor Idle 2 Demo. Ships no game data: it loads content.json from your own install.

scripts.bundle: npm run data && npm run assets && npm run audio && node tools/build-bundle.mjs
scripts.build:local: npm run data && npm run assets && npm run audio && npm run build && node -e "for (const f of ['game-assets','game-sounds','game-music']) require('fs').copyFileSync('data/'+f+'.pack','dist/'+f+'.pack')"
